purpose: Informational predictive-precedence and incremental-predictive-content check. This is not structural causal identification and cannot alter Fiscal V2 scoring, promotion status, Money Core, Funding V2, or the 10-point conviction rubric.

data_alignment.historical_fiscal_caveat: Uses current/revised FRED history with frozen conservative availability lags; not exact point-in-time release vintages.

stationarity.reason: Use a differenced Fiscal series for Granger to reduce spurious inference from persistence/non-stationarity.

granger.multiple_testing: Holm correction within each direction across the three fixed lags
granger.interpretation: Granger significance means predictive precedence conditional on own lags, not true economic causality.

incremental_predictive_regression.dependent_variable: SPY forward 12M log return starting in t+2
predictors: SPY trailing 12M log return known by month-end t+1
incremental_predictive_regression.interpretation: Checks whether Fiscal score adds information beyond prior market momentum; it is not structural causal identification.

lead_lag_placebo.interpretation: Forward association materially stronger than backward association is supportive but not causal proof.

decision_rule: No PASS/FAIL production gate. Report evidence as SUPPORTIVE_PREDICTIVE_PRECEDENCE, MIXED_OR_WEAK_PREDICTIVE_PRECEDENCE, or NO_PREDICTIVE_PRECEDENCE based on the frozen diagnostics, with explicit non-causal caveat.
